title: Soft Phases in Two-Dimensional O(N) Models
exact_target: Do spin correlations in the classical Heisenberg model, and other $O(N)$ models with $N>2$, decay exponentially at every nonzero temperature, or do these models have soft phases like the XY model? Prove or disprove that the low-temperature perturbative expansion is asymptotically correct, and determine whether there is a nonzero-temperature critical point and, if so, its critical indices.
